title: Green Grass Bridge
description: What would be sent to AWS IoT Greengrass, for parity: the greengrass-bridge mosquitto pulls the telemetry/# namespace off the device broker exactly like the on-Pi relay, Telegraf captures it, and this dashboard shows the Greengrass-bound stream next to the device-direct TMS stream.

panels.title: Bridge link
panels.description: The Green Grass Bridge's mosquitto connection into the device's embedded rumqttd broker (retained $SYS notification, pinned topic in greengrass-bridge.conf). Down means nothing is being pulled off the device — exactly what a real Greengrass relay outage would look like.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_bridge_state" and r._field == "connected")
  |> last()

panels.title: Greengrass-bound msgs (last 1 m)
panels.description: telemetry/# messages that crossed the bridge in the last minute. ~30 is healthy at the 2 s poll cadence (one merged legacy payload per poll); 0 means the tap, the bridge, or the consumer is down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.topic =~ /^telemetry\//)
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Bridge message rate
panels.description: Per-topic rate of the Greengrass-bound stream crossing the bridge.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.topic =~ /^telemetry\//)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)

panels.title: What would be sent to Greengrass (verbatim payloads)
panels.description: Verbatim tail of telemetry/{device_type}/{device_id} as pulled off the device by the Green Grass Bridge — the merged flat legacy JSON the on-Pi relay would push to the AWS IoT Greengrass core, byte-for-byte.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.topic =~ /^telemetry\//)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "topic", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", _value: "payload"})

panels.title: State of charge
panels.description: greengrass_telemetry.state_of_charge — percent, as the legacy schema ships it.

targets.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_telemetry" and r._field == "state_of_charge")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)

panels.title: Cell voltages

panels.title: Parity — state of charge
panels.description: Greengrass-bound state_of_charge (percent) vs device-direct TMS battery_cell.state_of_charge (a 0-1 fraction — scaled ×100 here, averaged across cells).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "greengrass_telemetry" and r._field == "state_of_charge")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "battery_cell" and r._field == "state_of_charge")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "device_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 100.0}))

panels.title: Parity — cell 0 voltage
